phases.name: social login refuses an unverified provider email and an empty one
phases.command: php artisan test --compact --filter='SocialAuthController.*(unverified provider|empty provider email)'
phases.note: LinkSocialAccount refuses a new identity unless the email is non-empty and the provider vouches for it: GitHub (driver returns only a verified primary address), Google (raw email_verified true); any other provider is refused. An already-linked identity still signs in.

phases.name: impersonation: end the log when a session expires or EnsureUserIsActive tears it down
phases.note: EnsureUserIsActive ends the impersonation through StopImpersonation when the target is deactivated, closing the log and restoring the admin. Each impersonated request stamps the log's updated_at (Impersonation::heartbeat), and the hourly impersonation:end-stale command closes a log idle for a session lifetime with ended_at set to its last use.

phases.name: impersonation: StartImpersonation checks the target is active
phases.note: StartImpersonation refuses a deactivated target with an AuthorizationException (403), and no log is written.

phases.name: impersonation: a target with no organization writes no activity row
phases.note: RecordModelActivity files an ImpersonationLog under its own organization_id, never the bound context. A target with no organization gets a platform-level activity row with a null organization, saved quietly so the creating hook cannot fill in the admin's organization.
